summary: Optional debug record of one NavCloud path search, filled by navcloud::PathfindingSystem when the path entity also has it (query PathInternal + PathRequest, PathResult, optional PathDebug; macOS ProcessRequests / ProcessSearches / SmoothNodes take it). Per-frame entry bg3.exe+0x7641F0 -> search lambda bg3.exe+0x3921AD0 passes the optional component (stride 0xE0) to the search bg3.exe+0x39200F0 (records every expanded node, honours an optional iteration limit) and to the finisher bg3.exe+0x3920DD0 (records the raw node path, copies the result and its flags) and the smoother bg3.exe+0x3936300 (records each straight-line test; a bool switches smoothing). Nothing in bg3.exe adds it; the leading block of 'unset' defaults (null entity, FLT_MAX floats, INT_MAX ints) and the colour-like 1.0 floats are only written by the default constructor - probably set by a debug tool. Both registry rows 224 bytes. Never seen alive.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x39200F0 appends one 0x18-byte element per expanded node: three floats computed as cell * 6.0 + local * size + size/2 (size 3.0 / 1.0 by resolution) = the node's world position.

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: fourth float written with the position (bg3.exe+0x39200F0); search cost-like value.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: written from the 8-byte pair (fVar33, fVar34) at element +0x10 (bg3.exe+0x39200F0).

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: second float of that pair.

fields.name: ResultFlags

fields.name: _Pad54

fields.name: VisitedNodes
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x39200F0 grows +0x58 (capacity +0x60, size +0x64) and appends 0x18-byte nodes; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6EC0 frees it (bg3.exe+0x5946C0).

fields.name: ResultPath
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3920DD0: bg3.exe+0x1BB22F0(component + 0x68, PathResult) copies the result path (16-byte nodes); destructor clears (bg3.exe+0x5BD630) and frees it.

fields.name: RawPath
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3920DD0 appends the first 12 bytes of each 16-byte node of the unsmoothed path to +0x78 (capacity +0x80, size +0x84), element stride 0xC.

fields.name: SmoothTests
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3936300 (macOS navcloud::SmoothNodes takes PathDebugComponent) appends 0x1C-byte elements to +0x88 (capacity +0x90, size +0x94).
